D3 ruling rule G16, for P11, written before its lines are ruled. P11 is shown when a concept shows members marking a work of the room's as up or achieved, at any hour (its range runs to credit and reflection at the close). That covers: announcing that the room's work is on the canvas ('we made it onto r/place', a post or link showing the mark as the room's), which shows P03's lower range at once (G15); celebrating it ('we did it', pride, congratulations, a final image posted as done, the work said to have lasted to the end); crediting makers and helpers (thanks, makers named, disputes over who made it, prizes or points given for the canvas work); a member claiming their own part in the work ('I helped', 'I did my part', the pixels or hours they gave); saying what working together meant, or what the work meant to the group (being seen, not being alone); an invitation to celebrate the work offline. The room's own word is enough: P11 does not require that the work be verified, finished, agreed or still standing, so a line saying a celebration does not prove these is ruled by its concepts. It is not shown by: a progress report or state report with no marking (P03); a member's placing or trying told as a step in a build still under way, with no claim of a share in a work (P03); a call, or a prize offered to recruit hands (P01); saving images, a timelapse, the work's fate, loss or mourning (P12; a final image posted as done shows both); contesting the version kept after hour 73 (P22); carrying the work on (P13); praise of another room's work or of the canvas at large with no tie to the room's own work (credit to another room for helping the room's work does show it); a bare mention of the event, a joke reception, a plan or wish to celebrate, a prize for something other than the canvas work. Under G9 a restrict line corrects P11 only if its condition is one P11 does not state and the room's concepts show P11 failing without it. Marking where no work is up (thanks or pride for an attempt, an interim state or a work lost before the close) is the form A07's bound already names; P11 does not say a room marks only what is up, so such a line is a paired elaboration when a second room shows it, not a correction. So is a find made by others that the room marks as its own, and marking that members dispute inside the room (some celebrate, others call it a failure or deny it stood). Under G2 an absent line is rejected when its concepts show P11; P11 is not universal (logged at the group's opening), so its absent lines are never corrections; G3 rules evidenced absences. A concept may show P03 and P11 at once (G15's 'done' reading). Draws: one per 100-line instantiate packet (G1b), a drawn line unsupported when its quotes change the ruling its how and labels would get

No correction: no restrict line shows P11 failing without its condition. Elaboration families so far, all paired: marking disputed inside the room (some celebrate, others call it a failure, deny it stood, or object to honouring it); marking where no work is up (an attempt, a remnant or a lost work thanked or praised, the form A07's bound names); progress celebrated before the work is up; a record of the work occasioning its marking (A08's late-side order); a flaw at the close read fondly and made the room's cheer; credit given in plans and calls before the work is up; a marked work reopening building; recognition sought from the creators the work depicts. One-room particular: nuclearthrone-041 (a host moderator removes a thank-you post; carried to T4-002). Readings as applied, under G16 as written: credit disputes (who made it, members or scripts) are P11's crediting, so specifications; a damaged final work claimed with pride is P11 as stated, the fond reading of the flaw being P12 (G13a) and keeping the damaged version P22; a celebration followed by renewed upkeep is P11 as stated, the upkeep P05's.
